name: IDT Corporation
summary: IDT Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides fintech and communications solutions in the United States, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates in four segments: National Retail Solutions, Fintech, Net2phone, and Traditional Communications. The company operates point of sale, a terminal-based platform which provides independent retailers with store management software, electronic payment processing, and other ancillary merchant services; and marketers with retail media advertising and transaction data.
